summary: Iteration 14 tested admin pricing (CAD), fee snapshots, the merchant priority toggle, priority-first routing, weekly merchant bills and statements, admin billing, and the 4 iteration-13 fixes. Backend: new suite test_pricing_billing.py passed 16/16. Full regression: 173/174 passed; the 1 failure (test_qr_windows::test_optimize_moves_urgent_stop_earlier) passed when rerun alone, so it is a flaky, time-of-day test and not a real regression. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG FOUND AND FIXED: the whole merchant screen /merchant/<id> crashed with 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {flexDirection, alignItems, gap, minHeight})'. The cause was left-over JSX text from a botched iteration-13 edit in ProblemAlertsCard.tsx:45 and WeeklyEmailCard.tsx:58 (' toggle(!a.enabled)} disabled={busy} style={s.row}>' sitting inside the View, which rendered the s.row style object as a child). I removed the stray text and the screen now renders. After the fix, all of these work on a 390px screen: merchant BILLING card (bill-total, bill-breakdown, bill-open, bill-line-<code>, 8 bill-week chips, bill-download fetching a 200 text/csv statement), order fee pills (CA$x.xx), order-priority toggle (toast 'MC47848 IS PRIORITY · NOW CA$16.50'; no button on routed orders), and the PRIORITY field in the fix-row sheet. The admin pricing screen works: loads defaults, the example updates live, save shows a green toast, tax 45 shows a red toast 'tax pct must be between 0 and 30', an empty field shows 'ENTER A NUMBER', the charge-failed switch persists, week chips switch the bill, and billing-total and billing-store-mer-1/mer-2 rows show. PRIORITY pills show on the admin route page. Iteration-13 fixes re-verified: each switch tap sends exactly 1 PUT; the /admin/drivers SAVE button fits (x 296 + width 78 <= 390, no horizontal scroll); a foreign stop shows 'This stop is on another driver's route' after 0.7s; admin reset clears merchant_alerts and report_emails. Pricing defaults, mer-1 alerts and weekly email are restored, demo PINs still work, and an admin reset was run at the end. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) were found.

minor.issue: Loads every stop of the store with .sort('delivered_at', 1).to_list(5000). This is ascending order with a cap, so once a store has more than 5000 stops the NEWEST ones are dropped, and the current week's bill would silently miss lines. Filter by delivered_at inside the week in the Mongo query (plus a separate count for open orders) instead of scanning everything. admin_billing repeats this full scan for every merchant.
The 400 message uses the raw key name ('tax pct must be between 0 and 30', 'base fee ...'), and the UI shows it as-is in lowercase. Use friendly labels such as 'Sales tax must be between 0 and 30%'.

ui_bugs.issue: CRASH (now FIXED by testing agent): stray JSX text left by the iteration-13 edit rendered a style object as a child, so the whole merchant screen showed 'Something went wrong'.

Priority stops come first, so the priority drop is usually the NEXT STOP hero card, which shows no PRIORITY indicator. The /driver/stop/[stopId] screen has none either. Seen: TEST_UIB (priority) was the hero and no PRIORITY appeared anywhere on the driver screen.
window.open('') before fetching the link leaves an empty about:blank tab open after the CSV downloads, because the response is a Content-Disposition attachment. Seen: 2 pages stayed open.
pricing-example uses Number(form[k]), but save() first replaces ',' with '.'. Typing '1,25' shows 0 in the live example while 1.25 is what gets saved.

compute_fee falls back to CURRENT pricing for stops with fee=None, both in merchant_bill and in the startup backfill. This is acceptable today because seeded stops have no merchant_id, but any merchant stop created without a fee would be priced at today's rates rather than its booking-time rates.

rca_of_issue: Merchant screen crash: the iteration-13 'one PUT per tap' change removed a Pressable wrapper, but the replacement left the old opening tag's tail (' toggle(!x.enabled)} disabled={...} style={s.row}>') as JSX text inside the new <View>. JSX treated {busy}/{s.row} as children, so React threw on the style object. Repro: open /merchant/mer-1 logged in as bakery@multidrop.app -> red 'Something went wrong'. Fix: removed the stray text in both components; verified the screen renders and each switch tap sends 1 PUT.
